to: you: only the socket of the character

fields.name: name
fields.description: The achievement. Each name except `"unlucky"` is a key of `G.achievements`.

senders.what: `add_achievement`: it adds 1 to `player.p.achievements[name]`, then sends the event.
`item_achievement_increment`: the counter on an equipped item reaches `G.achievements[name].count`. The item gets the title as its `p` property, then a `player` update follows.
The `compound` handler: the roll equals the success chance (to 4 decimals). The achievement is `"lucky"`.
The `upgrade` handler: the roll equals the chance (to 4 decimals). A success on an item of grade 1 or more gives `"lucky"`. Failure gives `"unlucky"`.
